showroom: Beirut, Lebanon; address not assigned. Acoustic-piano and long amplifier demonstrations by appointment.

orders.policy: Chatbot gives information and can record customer interest; staff must confirm order, invoice, item configuration and any delivery charge. Chatbot cannot process payment, place binding orders, or reserve stock.
orders.price_exclusions: Delivery and optional services are not included in product list prices; taxes or other charges, if applicable, are confirmed by staff.
orders.special_order: Zero-stock special-order models show indicative prices only. Staff must confirm sourcing, finish, final quote, lead time and deposit terms before a customer commits.

pickup.policy: Free showroom pickup once staff confirms the item is ready. Valid for items that can be collected safely; grand/upright logistics are arranged separately.

delivery.eligible_items: Boxed guitars, amps, accessories and suitable portable/cabinet digital pianos, subject to staff check.
delivery.other_areas: Staff quote based on location, accessibility and product size.
delivery.typical_beirut_window: 2-5 business days after staff confirmation, illustrative estimate only
delivery.typical_mount_lebanon_window: 3-7 business days after staff confirmation, illustrative estimate only
delivery.acoustic_pianos: Never use standard parcel delivery rates; professional moving, stairs/access, inspection and any tuning are quoted separately. No fixed delivery time promise.

returns.standard_stock: Unused standard-stock merchandise may be requested for return within 14 calendar days of customer receipt, with proof of purchase, original packaging and all accessories; inspection and eligibility required.
returns.exclusions: Custom/special-order products and acoustic pianos are subject to individually agreed sale terms disclosed before purchase; opened consumables such as strings are ordinarily not eligible for change-of-mind return.
returns.return_shipping: Customer covers return transport for change-of-mind requests; store reviews damaged, defective or incorrect goods separately.
returns.refund_timing: When approved, store aims to process refunds within 10 business days after inspection using the original payment method where possible.
returns.legal_caveat: Nothing in these fictional store policies overrides any rights customers may have under applicable consumer law.

warranties.policy: Manufacturer warranty duration and coverage vary by brand/model, seller region and registration terms. Never guarantee a uniform period.
warranties.handling: Store helps customers start an inquiry with proof of purchase; manufacturer/dealer terms are verified for the individual product before commitments.

services.name: Instrument and setup advice
services.details: Free buying advice and standard in-store demonstrations during opening hours.

services.name: Basic guitar setup (labor only)
services.details: By appointment; replacement parts and unusual repairs quoted separately.

services.name: Digital piano connectivity orientation
services.details: Brief basic guidance, subject to staff availability; not a technical installation guarantee.

unknown_answers: If a required fact is absent from the approved data, admit uncertainty and log through record_feedback(question). Do not invent contact details, stock, warranties, suppliers or shipping commitments.
